title: 第7章 真气救人第8章 终于有车了
slug: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
走出商城，凉风一吹，几人回过神来。
郁景想着：总算是走出来了，再来几波买买买，自己这小心脏也受不了。
一阵嘈杂声传来，六人看去。
郁凡一眼便看出倒在地上的老人呼吸循环衰竭，已经出现了脑出血。
四周的人群谁都不敢贸然上前，只留着稍微的距离，拨打了120。
“有人摔倒了吗？”郁凌看到周围的议论声，连忙跑了过去。
郁嘉庆看到这种情况也焦急不已，想要上前去扶起老人，又担心自己的移动会伤害到人。
郁凡看到孩子们都有些焦急的模样，原本不欲管他人的生老病死，想了想，还是决定救上一救。
罢了，罢了，就算与他有缘吧。
郁凡走过去，稍稍释放出自己的气势，四周的人瞬间感觉一阵压迫感传来，不由自主的将道路让了出来。
他走至老人面前，将手轻轻的搭在老人手腕上，状似在把脉，实际上是将自己的真气传入老人的体中。
有人鼓起勇气喊道：“不要随便挪动他，要是真出了事，你可负不起这个责任。”
郁嘉庆想到父亲能将自己救醒，必然是有着不俗的医术的，便对着大家说道：“我父亲是个医生，让他看看。”
他的话让周围的疑惑不解，父亲？哪儿来的老中医吗？
“那让你父亲来看看啊。”周围有个年轻小伙子说。
郁嘉庆指了指郁凡的方向，“那不就是吗？”
四周一片轰然，这人是在开玩笑吗？这么紧急的时候，居然开这种无聊的玩笑！
不少人都怒视着他。
郁嘉庆的话让郁凡想到了现在的世界不可能随便让一个人就从接近死亡的状态下变成活蹦乱跳的。
于是拿出自己以前收藏的雀氏金针，在老人的脖子后面和脑门上各扎了一针。

以金针渡气，更快速的将老人体内衰老的器官恢复生机。
没一会儿，老人便醒了过来。
郁凡也将针给收了回来。
“好了，你们送他去医院就可以了。”郁凡对四周的人说道，便站起身对着孩子们摆摆手示意了下。
看到老人醒了过来，四周的人总算是敢上前，之前问话的年轻小伙子连忙扶起老人，敬佩的看着已经走出了一段距离的郁凡喃喃说道：“原来真的是中医啊，这技术，厉害了！”
几人在回去路上，三个孩子都一脸崇拜的看着。
没想到他们爷爷居然这么厉害！
原本听妈说爷爷帮助了爸爸的恢复，还以为爸爸原本就动完手术恢复了不少，正好爷爷加了把力，使他提前醒来了。
刚才那老人一看就知道情况很危急，可爷爷仅仅只是短短的几分钟，便让他恢复了过来。
爷爷这医术，堪称神术啊！
事实上，也确实是使用的神仙法术了，修仙之人，对于人体脉络是最为清楚的，更别提郁凡强大的神识可以直接看穿人体的奇经八脉，简直就是一个人体扫描仪，有什么病症之类的，一眼便能看出。
感受到孩子们崇敬的眼神，郁凡脑中闪过一抹想法，转瞬即逝。
回到家中后，郁凡便回了自己的房间。
今天使用了不少真气，不知道目前蓝星的灵气是否能快速的将自己的真气弥补回来。
content_en:
After walking out of the mall, the cool breeze blew and several people came back to their senses.
Yu Jing thought: I have finally come out, and my little heart won’t be able to bear a few more rounds of shopping.
There was a noise and the six people looked over.
Yu Fan could tell at a glance that the old man lying on the ground had respiratory and circulatory failure and had cerebral hemorrhage.
No one in the surrounding crowd dared to step forward rashly. They only kept a slight distance and dialed 120.
"Did someone fall?" Yu Ling saw the commotion around him and ran over quickly.
Yu Jiaqing was anxious when he saw this situation. He wanted to go forward and help the old man up, but he was worried that his movement would hurt people.
Yu Fan saw that the children were a little anxious. He didn't want to care about other people's life, old age, illness or death. After thinking about it, he decided to save them.
That's all, that's all, let's just consider it a fate with him.
Yu Fan walked over and released his momentum a little. The people around him instantly felt a sense of oppression and involuntarily moved out of the way.
He walked up to the old man and gently put his hand on the old man's wrist, as if feeling his pulse. In fact, he was passing his own energy into the old man's body.
Someone plucked up the courage and shouted: "Don't move him casually. If something happens, you can't bear the responsibility."
Yu Jiaqing thought that his father must have good medical skills if he could revive him, so he said to everyone: "My father is a doctor, let him take a look."
His words confused the people around him. Father? Where did the old Chinese doctor come from?
"Then let your father come and take a look." A young man around said.
Yu Jiaqing pointed in the direction of Yu Fan, "Isn't that right?"
There was a roar all around. Is this person kidding? How dare you make such a silly joke in such an emergency!
Many people glared at him.
Yu Jiaqing's words made Yu Fan think that in today's world, it is impossible for just one person to change from a state of near death to being alive and kicking.
So he took out the Que's Golden Needle that he had collected before, and stuck a needle on the back of the old man's neck and one on his forehead.
Using gold needles to move Qi, the aging organs in the elderly can be rejuvenated more quickly.
After a while, the old man woke up.
Yu Fan also took the needle back.
"Okay, just take him to the hospital." Yu Fan said to the people around him, then stood up and waved to the children.
Seeing that the old man had woken up, people around him finally dared to step forward. The young man who had asked the question quickly helped the old man up. He looked at Yu Fan who had walked some distance away with admiration and murmured: "It turns out he is really a Chinese medicine doctor. This technique is amazing!"
As they were walking back, the three children looked at them with admiration.
I didn’t expect their grandpa to be so powerful!
Originally, I heard my mother say that my grandfather helped my father recover, and I thought that my father had already recovered a lot after the operation, but it happened that my grandfather added more force and made him wake up early.
The old man knew that the situation was critical at the first glance, but it only took a few minutes for grandpa to recover.
Grandpa’s medical skills are truly magical!
In fact, it was indeed an immortal spell used. Immortal cultivators have the clearest knowledge of the human body's veins, not to mention that Yu Fan's powerful spiritual consciousness can directly see through the eight extraordinary meridians of the human body. It is simply a human body scanner. Any disease or the like can be seen at a glance.
Feeling the adoring eyes of the children, an idea flashed through Yu Fan's mind, and it disappeared in an instant.
After returning home, Yu Fan went back to his room.
I used a lot of infuriating energy today, and I wonder if Blue Star's current aura can quickly make up for his infuriating energy.
